spec.assertion: buffApply stat normalAttackPct value 30, targetSlug jill only. SCOPE: the buff's damage cost is measured with the sustained DoT live vs removed; the ratio must be 1 (normal-only). Fails under the nearest-wrong attackDamagePct 30, which also lifts the 192%/s ticks -> ratio > 1.

buffApply.durationShots === 9. Fails under durationSec:9 or a bare always-on passive — both are damage-equivalent at the base 9-round magazine, so only the event field discriminates; the divergence becomes real under any max-ammo change.

spec.kitLine: start of battle + reload to max
spec.assertion: the buff re-applies >20 times and at least (jill reload count - 1). Fails under a one-shot t=0 application.

buffApply count of trueDamagePct 34.99 === jill burstCast count AND < fullBurstStart count. Fails under the nearest-wrong fullBurstEnter keying, which over-fires on every rotation the second Burst III (helm) completes. Plus: zeroing it must reduce jill's total (non-inert) and leave every teammate byte-identical (self scope).

Removing all dot effects must cut jill's total by >5% (non-vacuous). MAINTAIN-vs-STACK: re-keying the DoT to a per-magazine trigger holding a 30s window must yield >2x jill's total — proving the shipped model is one maintained instance, not ~14 stacked copies (the engine never dedups DoT instances, and the magazine cycle is ~2s against a 30s window). A ratio near 1 means the shipped model already stacks.

buffApply count of atkPct 40.03 on jill === fullBurstStart count AND > jill burstCast count. Fails under the nearest-wrong burstCast keying, which under-credits every Full Burst helm completes. Value asserted as the raw percentage 40.03 (plain stat, not caster-scaled flat ATK).

buffApply reloadSpeedPct 99.96 on jill, AND zeroing it strictly reduces both jill's shot count and her total — weapon-state gates shot count, so 'defensive, skip' is the wrong call. The 'fixed at' CLAMP semantics are a separate skipped gap.

Dropping consumeAmmo must strictly reduce jill's reload count AND her Magnum Ammo re-application count — the kit combo is burst -> ammo dump -> forced reload-to-max -> fresh Magnum + fresh Acid. Fails if consumeAmmo is absent or does not force the reload (both counts equal).

buffApply hitRatePct 80.78 on jill, and zeroing it strictly reduces her total — proving it is wired to the core-hit lift rather than parked as an inert stat. Fails under encoding it as generic crit/attack damage only insofar as the magnitude differs; the magnitude itself is left unasserted (⚑ measured-only).

buffApply attackDamagePct 75 on jill only; teammates byte-identical when zeroed. BUCKET: its damage cost must be strictly LARGER with the DoT live than without (Damage-Up credits sustained ticks). Fails under a normal-scoped encoding (equal costs). A ratio of exactly 1 is instead the finding that the engine excludes sustained ticks from the Damage-Up bucket — report, do not re-encode.

No standalone primitive exists for timed true-flavored normals (only weaponSwap.trueNormals). Asserted INDIRECTLY: skill1's trueDamagePct 34.99 must move damage, which is only possible if some of jill's damage is true-flavored. Direct per-shot flavor tagging is it.skip'd.

The burst slot must contain no flatDamage / dot / storedHit effect, and the whole file no heal/shield/fillGauge/gainPierce/burstCdr/fullBurstExtend/stun/burstEligibility/reenterStage, hasPierce falsy, and every block target self (or enemy for the boss-facing DoT). Fails under any invented burst nuke or ally-scoped grant — the kit says 'Affects self' on every line.

fixtures: controlComp('jill', true) only — liter B1 / crown B2 / jill B3 (focus) / helm B3, deterministic (no seed). The fixed helm B3 slot is deliberately KEPT rather than passed false: a second Burst III is the only thing that makes team Full Bursts strictly outnumber jill's own burst casts, which is what lets the burstCast (S1b True Damage) and fullBurstEnter (S2b ATK) trigger-identity assertions discriminate at all. A lone Burst III casts zero bursts and every burst assertion would be vacuous — an explicit non-vacuity guard asserts fullBurstStart count > jill burstCast count and flags a fixture problem if not. 11 hoisted 180s runs: base, magnum zeroed, DoT dropped, DoT+magnum, trueDamage zeroed, hitRate zeroed, attackDamage zeroed, DoT+attackDamage, reloadSpeed zeroed, consumeAmmo dropped, DoT re-keyed to the stacking nearest-wrong. The two DoT-present/DoT-absent pairs exist solely to give scope (normal-only vs Damage-Up) a label-free discriminator that needs no damage-event bucket field name.
gaps: burst 'Reload speed is FIXED at a 99.96% increase' — the CLAMP is a distinct primitive from the additive reloadSpeedPct buff (engine has no clamp); a co-active reload buff would stack above the fixed value. it.skip.

burst 'Normal attacks deal True Damage for 10 sec' — no standalone true-flavor-normals effect outside weaponSwap.trueNormals; direct per-shot flavor assertion needs a damage-event flavor field not documented in the packet. it.skip (covered indirectly via the S1b non-inertness test).
burst 'Hit Rate ▲ 80.78%' magnitude — the Hit-Rate -> core-rate conversion is a ⚑ derived/measured-only constant, not assertable from kit text. it.skip (presence + non-inertness are asserted).

skill2 Acid Ammo per-tick flavor 'sustained' and non-core status — damage-event bucket/flavor field names are not in the packet, so tick-level labelling cannot be asserted blind. it.skip (the maintain-vs-stack behaviour is asserted via totals instead).

Not a gap but a blind risk flagged for the judge: two spellings of the override file are documented in the packet (ov.skill1: Block[] vs ov.skill1.blocks: Block[]), and unit-attribution field names on shot/reload/burstCast events are unspecified — the test tolerates both shapes and several field names, and a leading 'harness wiring' describe makes a miss legible as one failure rather than ten.
